questions.q: ___ home, I met Tom. (while I was walking)
questions.why: Дія відбувається одночасно з головною й підмет той самий (я йшов і зустрів) — *-ing*: *Walking home, I met Tom.*

questions.q: ___ work, she left. (after she had finished)
questions.why: Дія відбулася раніше за головну — *Having* + третя форма: *Having finished work, she left.*

questions.q: ___ in 1900, the house is old. (which was built)
questions.why: Будинок збудували (пасив) — третя форма: *Built in 1900, the house is old.*

questions.q: Which is a dangling participle (wrong)?
options: Walking home, it started to rain.
questions.why: У звороті має бути той самий підмет, що в головному реченні. *Walking home, it started to rain* означає, що дощ ішов додому, — це помилка.

questions.q: The man ___ there is my uncle. (who is standing)
questions.why: Скорочене означальне: *The man (who is) standing there…*

questions.q: The letter ___ by Tom is on the desk. (which was written)
questions.why: Пасивне значення — третя форма: *The letter written by Tom…*

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: After to finish work, she left.
questions.why: Після сполучника (*After*) — *-ing*: *After finishing work…*

questions.q: 'Having been warned, he left' means:
options: he was warned before he left
questions.why: *Having been warned* — його попередили раніше, ніж він пішов.

questions.q: Participle clauses are most common in:
questions.why: Такі звороти частіше трапляються в письмовій мові.

questions.q: ___ (feel) tired, I went to bed early.
questions.why: Причина й той самий підмет — *Feeling tired, I went to bed.*

questions.q: ___ (finish) the report, she sent it to her boss.
questions.why: Спочатку закінчила, потім надіслала — *Having finished*.

questions.q: The car ___ (park) outside is mine.
questions.why: Машину припаркували (пасив) — *parked*.

questions.q: Before ___ (leave), check the windows.
questions.why: Після *before* — *-ing*: *Before leaving*.

questions.q: ___ by the noise, the baby started crying.
questions.why: Дитину розбудив шум (пасив) — *Woken by the noise*.

questions.q: The girl ___ next to Anna is my cousin.
questions.why: *The girl (who is) sitting…*

questions.q: ___ the door, he found a letter.
questions.why: Одночасна дія — *Opening the door, he found a letter.*

questions.q: ___ his keys, he couldn't get in.
questions.why: Загубив раніше, тому не міг увійти — *Having lost his keys*.

answer: Having finished dinner we went out
Having finished dinner, we went out
questions.why: *Having finished dinner, we went out.*

answer: The woman standing by the door is my boss
questions.why: *The woman standing by the door…*
questions.hint: Жінка, що стоїть біля дверей, — моя начальниця.

answer: Made in Italy these shoes are expensive
Made in Italy, these shoes are expensive
questions.why: Пасив — *Made in Italy*.
questions.hint: Зроблені в Італії, ці черевики дорогі.

questions.q: ___ a car, we had to walk.
questions.why: Заперечення — *Not* перед зворотом: *Not having a car, we had to walk.*

questions.q: The letters ___ yesterday arrived today.
questions.why: Листи надіслали (пасив) — *sent*.

questions.q: ___ (finish) the report, she went home.
questions.why: Раніше за головну дію — *Having finished*.

questions.q: ___ prices rising, people are spending less.
questions.why: *With* + іменник + *-ing* — абсолютний зворот зі своїм підметом: *With prices rising…*

questions.q: ___ by his accent, he's from Scotland.
questions.why: *Judging by* — сталий вираз «судячи з».

questions.q: If ___ (ask), say you don't know.
questions.why: *If asked* = *if you are asked*.
